Furlenco: Rent & Buy Furniture

Welcome to your favourite online furniture app-now in an all-new avatar!
Whether you want to rent short-term, rent long-term, buy brand new, or score a great deal on refurbished pieces, Furlenco gives you the ultimate freedom to furnish your home exactly the way you want. Enjoy amazing offers, lightning-fast 72-hour free delivery and installation, and no-cost EMI options!

Furnish Every Corner of Your Home
 
• Bedroom Furniture: Upgrade your sleep with our premium designs, including King Beds, Queen Beds, Single Beds, and spacious Wardrobes.

• Living Room Furniture: Reflect your personal style with chic 3-Seater Sofas, L-Shaped Sofas, Sofa-Cum-Beds, Recliners, and stylish TV Units.

• Dining Room Furniture: Make every meal special with our range of elegant 4-Seater and 6-Seater Dining Tables.

• Study Room Furniture: Unlock your productivity with our comfortable Study Tables, Workstations, and Ergonomic Office Chairs.

• Storage Solutions: Declutter your space and your life with our smart, sleek storage units.

• Outdoor Seating: Create a happy balcony or patio retreat with our durable garden chairs and tables.

• Home & Kitchen Appliances: Make everyday life seamless. Rent top-quality Single & Double-Door Refrigerators, Washing Machines, Microwaves, Smart TVs, ACs, and Water Purifiers.

Why download Furlenco app?
We are introducing true freedom to the world of furniture. Here is why your wallet (and your home) will love us:

• Total Flexibility: Choose exactly how you want to bring furniture home. Rent it or buy it, new or refurbished-you are in control.

• Exclusive, In-House Designs: Fall in love with original pieces that perfectly blend aesthetics, functionality, and comfort.

• Built to Last: With premium materials, resilient fabrics, and stringent quality checks, our furniture stays looking newer for longer.

• Unbeatable Value: Enjoy damage waivers, free installation, manufacturer warranties, no-cost EMIs, and a flexible "terminate-to-own" option so you get the most out of every purchase.

Now Delivering Across India
We are proud to serve happy homes in: Bengaluru, Mumbai, Pune, Delhi, Gurugram, Noida, Ghaziabad, Faridabad, Hyderabad, Chennai, Jaipur, Mysuru, Chandigarh, Vijayawada, Nashik, Kolkata, Ahmedabad, Ambala, Panipat, Sonipat, Karnal, Patiala, Meerut, Hosur, Gandhinagar, Lucknow, Indore, Coimbatore, Bhopal, Kanpur, Kochi, Puducherry, and Vadodara.

Download the Furlenco app
